items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShell
items.description: Page frame: skip link first in tab order, dark header banner, named main landmark, optional nav and footer. Mobile: nav collapses behind a disclosure button (aria-expanded) below the lg container width. Optional grid and vignette slots sit behind the content.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Put <Sidebar/> in the nav slot and pass <GridBackground/> and <Vignette/> to the decorative slots if wanted. The default story is plain paper: decor appears only in the Authentic story. Migration (v3): the scanline/vignette overlay no longer sits over the default shell; pass grid and vignette explicitly to keep it.
